venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Steady start to Friday. Guest flow picked up around 9pm, sales peak around 11pm. Stayed busy past midnight to last call around 2am. No barback tonight. Toast clocks everyone out at 4am.

highlights.text: Sales peak around 11pm. Steady past midnight. Dan's birthday celebration!
86'd: Red wine, Lairds, Woodford Rye, Ocho Repo, and others

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: A 'Good Friday' — vibes were vibing all night long! Lots of industry people came to hang even on a busy Friday. Great food sales from Jarred and Tay.

highlights.text: Lots of industry people hanging at the spot on a busy Friday

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Steady and busier morning with great weather driving traffic. Ezra's first live morning shift — did great. Slower start to Friday evening until 6pm. SMF Lucas show at 8pm drove a 6:30–7:30 rush with 20+ kitchen tickets. Big exodus for show at 7:45. Hot Eye packed from 11pm–midnight post-show. Band member from tour stayed until close!

highlights.text: Ezra's first live morning shift. Kitchen crushed 20+ ticket rush.
Band member from Lucas tour show stayed until close

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: Pretty steady Friday. First weekend with Toast POS — big learning experience but team worked together. Decent walk-ins first hour. Standing room had nice presence. Lull around 10pm then large waitlist. Great burn and turn to get everyone seated. Standing room mellowed at 12:30, moved folks to marquee for last push.

highlights.text: First weekend with Toast POS. Team worked together to figure it out.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Killer Friday. Maggie and Lily worked out great method to run floor with one host, set pace for the evening. Closing art exhibition for Lazy Cowgirl in Vauxhall with 80+ guests. Great attitudes and solid vibes throughout. Dom and Cosette truly shined!

highlights.text: Art exhibition for Lazy Cowgirl with 80+ guests in Vauxhall

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: Chill night. Busier in the middle as expected, first and last turns felt a little empty. Made it through waitlist around midnight. Bowen's last shift — lots of industry friends came to celebrate. Walk-in investor with 6-top rounded out end of night. Vestibule doors open for beautiful weather!

highlights.text: Bowen's last shift — lots of industry friends came to celebrate
Walk-in investor with 6-top rounded out the end of the night
Top Sellers: Core Slight, Masari, Root & Rye/Year of the Trees

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.notes_summary: Decent night in the Garden. Slow start but walk-ins picked up. Biggest push around 8:45pm. Service ran smoothly. Marquee lull from 6:30–8:30pm then later reservations filled in. From 10:45pm–midnight, room filled with larger groups celebrating. Good food sales at 12.27%.

highlights.text: Garden open with good walk-in traffic. Larger groups celebrating 10:45pm–midnight.
